Neovim maps Y to y$ by default (:help Y-default, `nvim --clean` keeps it); codemirror-vim's Y is Vim's yy. Seen as Yp/YP; the match is only Y directly followed by p/P (not <C-Y>), so other Y shapes (3Y, dY, Y with a later put) are still reported. Note for the neovim editor profile: the app does not map Y to y$.
